source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Whenever this unit finishes a **[Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)**, pick 1 enemy unit in **[Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** of this unit. Then:

1. Roll a D6 for each model of this unit in Engagement Range of the picked unit.
2. Each 4+ deals D3 **[mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)** to the picked unit.
3. If these mortal wounds destroy any of its models, the picked unit takes a [Battle-shock test](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock).
